t: Where to Find Reclaimed Wood | Budget Dumpster
s: If you’re looking for free reclaimed wood, talk to the foreman at a local construction site to see if you can take any old lumber off their hands. If you do find reclaimed wood in a dumpster, just be sure to get permission before taking it, as the contractors may actually have plans to recycle the wood themselves. When in doubt, always ask. Most cities provide lists of ongoing projects in the area, so to find construction sites near you, search for “local city building projects” online.
